Ticket Id: 195814

Dr Christine Hodges
2 Hill Forest Road
Newtown

11 February 2019

Dear Dr Hodges

Re: Mr John Aloisius
DOB: 04/09/1985

Thank you for seeing Mr John Aloisius, who has recently been diagnosed with pulmonary tuberculosis. He
is now ready for discharge and follow-up at your clinic.

Mr Aloisius was admitted to the ED on 01/02/2019 with a recent history of productive cough with
hemoptysis. Additionally, he had a fever and night sweating. His oxygen saturation was 92%. Examination     Commented [ESLDOC1]: sweats
revealed cachexia and scattered rales were auscultated. The diagnosis of pulmonary tuberculosis was
confirmed after observing apical lung infiltrates on an X-ray, and detecting a positive culture for
mycobacterium TB.                                                                                           Commented [ESLDOC2]: M
                                                                                                            Commented [ESLDOC3]: tuberculosis
During hospitalisation, Mr Aloisius was placed on a respiratory isolation room and TB medications were      Commented [ESLDOC4]: in
subsequently commenced along with vitamin B6. The nursing team ensured adequate diet and use of
medications.

Today, Mr Aloisius’s condition has significantly improved, with a negative mycobacterium culture.

Please note, Mr Aloisius will be discharged on the following medications; pyrazinamide, ethambutol,
isoniazide and rifampin for two months. After that, he should continue isoniazid and rifampin for an
additional four months. He should also continue taking vitamin B-6.

Kindly monitor Mr Aloisius for medication compliance, check his serum creatinine and liver enzymes for
drug toxicity and assess his visual acuity and red-green color perception with an Ishihara test.

Should there be any queries, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely

Doctor
